declared: 2026-09-30, before any post-landing frame was ingested or analysed
purpose: Held-out validation on every usable frame that shows the landed IM-2 Athena: the nine frames of configs/post_landing_check.json plus fifteen more. Same expectations and thresholds as that plan, compared with the same pre-landing campaign, and afterwards with the nine-frame run to see what the extra frames add. These frames never enter the counterfactual.

ingest.catalog_source: ODE EDRNAC4 query of 2026-09-30 (solar_sweep_query.py --lat -84.7906 --lon 29.1957 --halfwidth-km 3 --before 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z --all-frames); every frame after the landing day with the site inside the strip and the Sun at least 1.5 degrees up

known_risks: cam2map projects each frame without removing all relief, so relief shifts a frame by its height times tan(emission). The audited gate stopped at 40 degrees for that reason; frames at 41 to 60 degrees may fail co-registration closure and be dropped by the ingest, which reports it.
Oblique frames resolve less along the look direction, so their shadows are blurrier than the detector's point-spread assumption.
The two edge-margin frames put the site 427 m and 309 m inside the strip, below the 600 m registration window the ingest was built around; campt decides whether they are usable.
M1526725737RE is a right-camera frame from February 2026, eleven months after the others.

known_object.name: IM-2 Athena lander
known_object.state: on its side within a 20 m crater whose floor was shadowed in LROC's post-landing images

expectations: E1. Rocks do not move. Casters measured in the pre-landing stack reappear in the post-landing stack, and the reverse, more often than shifted copies of the same sets: z of at least 3 both ways, outside the disturbed disc.
E2. Where a caster is found in both stacks, its height lower bounds agree: median absolute difference at most 0.2 m.
E3. The relief model recovers real topography: the metre-scale shape-from-shading detail of the two stacks correlates at 0.3 or more, and at least 3 standard deviations above shifted copies.
E4. Warnings after the relief correction, at the measured noise, repeat beyond chance: z of at least 3.

E5. At the lander the method either warns or says unknown; it never reports a quiet reading inside the shadowed crater. Everything within 100 m of the lander is described separately and excluded from E1 to E4, because the landing changed the surface there.
